body: Additional evidence-standard attack: claim graph still marks high-risk C-02/03/04/05/06/07/10/11 partial/unresolved while the report states them as settled recommendations and release gates. Physical dual-monitor, field-network, Korean STT, RAG, pairing UX tests remain pending. Please treat these as explicit Phase-0 evidence closures/spikes; docs prove capability constraints, not that this implementation meets them. Also flag that summing component p95s does not establish end-to-end p95.
